topic: Reviewing and authoring Cloudflare Workers code against production best practices: streaming, floating promises, global state, secrets, observability, and common Workers anti-patterns.

subtopics.scope: Retrieval-first discipline: fetch latest @cloudflare/workers-types via npm pack, wrangler types for Env, wrangler config-schema.json, and the Cloudflare best-practices page before writing or reviewing any Workers code
seed_queries: Cloudflare Workers @cloudflare/workers-types npm install latest types
wrangler types command generate Env bindings Cloudflare

subtopics.scope: Configuration rules: compatibility_date freshness, nodejs_compat flag, wrangler types Env generation, wrangler secret put, wrangler.jsonc over wrangler.toml
seed_queries: Cloudflare Workers compatibility_date nodejs_compat wrangler.jsonc best practices
wrangler secret put secrets environment variables Cloudflare Workers

subtopics.scope: Request and response handling: streaming large or unbounded payloads, never await response.text() on unbounded data, ctx.waitUntil for post-response work, no ctx destructuring
seed_queries: Cloudflare Workers stream response body memory limit await response.text
Cloudflare Workers ctx.waitUntil post-response background work

subtopics.scope: Architecture: in-process bindings (KV, R2, D1, Queues) over the Cloudflare REST API, service bindings for Worker-to-Worker calls, Queues and Workflows off the critical path, Hyperdrive for external PostgreSQL and MySQL
seed_queries: Cloudflare Workers bindings KV R2 D1 instead of REST API best practice
Cloudflare Hyperdrive PostgreSQL service bindings Workers Queues

subtopics.scope: Observability: enable observability in wrangler.jsonc with head_sampling_rate, structured JSON logging, Workers logs and traces
seed_queries: Cloudflare Workers observability head_sampling_rate wrangler config
Cloudflare Workers structured JSON logging tail workers logs

subtopics.scope: Code patterns: no module-level mutable request state, every Promise awaited, returned, voided, or passed to ctx.waitUntil (floating promises)
seed_queries: Cloudflare Workers floating promises anti-pattern await
Cloudflare Workers global state module scope request isolation anti-pattern

subtopics.scope: Security: crypto.randomUUID and crypto.getRandomValues over Math.random, crypto.subtle.timingSafeEqual for secret comparison, no passThroughOnException as error handling, secrets not in source or config

Cloudflare Workers passThroughOnException error handling anti-pattern
